For this question I am going to calculate and compare which species, among human, pig, and mouse, had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain.

Human
```{r}
total_elevated_gene_human<-sum(180,83,57,110)
print(total_elevated_gene_human)
```

Pig
```{r}
total_elevated_gene_pig<-sum(109,157,31,45)
print(total_elevated_gene_pig)
```

Mouse
```{r}
total_elevated_gene_mouse<-sum(55,185,60,98)
print(total_elevated_gene_mouse)
```

So the highest number is 430 in human.
